verified_facts: INSPIRE polygons represent registered freehold property
each polygon carries a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID
the INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title
Find a Property can use INSPIRE ID to obtain title registration and plan
INSPIRE is not the complete Index Polygons database
candidate identity must be bound from actual runtime data rather than inferred from local-authority names
quality_effect: Separates real title binding from local-authority or geometry inference.
